content.short: Enterprise payment platform that unifies acquirers, payment methods and data in one integration.
content.description: PXP lets large merchants connect once and orchestrate multiple acquirers, payment methods and systems around the world, with routing designed to send each transaction down the best path and real-time analytics on the results. It processes over €30 billion a year across retail, hospitality, gaming and other sectors, and has added stablecoin payments to its FX and settlement options.
content.meta: PXP connects enterprises to multiple acquirers and payment methods through one integration, processing €30B+ a year.
